main_text.p: labore perfuncti sumus, præcipuè Dallæi argumenta adversus omnes doctissimi Vindiciarum Auctoris objectiones defen-dimus, & ab ejus Vindicavimus exce-ptionibus, idem de cæteris facili negotio facturi, nisi abundè sufficerent quæ ex-pendimus, ut Ignatio Apostolorum disci-pulo, sanctissimoque Christi martyri ab-judicentur, quæ illius nomen falsò præ-ferunt Epistolæ.

page.notes: The page number is printed as "331" in old type; read from the sequence, not fully certain of the final digit. The running head is printed in italic. FINIS is printed in spaced italic capitals, centred. The Google digitisation watermark at bottom right and the scan edge at the right are left out.
